description: ArduPilot adapter overrides for a px4-ekf-flow (plugin) PID tuning profile. EKF: NavEKF3 is ready ~33 s after start (ArduPilot's GPS checks), PX4's EKF2 ~10 s. Search ranges: with ArduPilot's gyro low-pass (INS_GYRO_FILTER) the rate loop is stable only with a small rate P (ArduPilot's default 0.135), and a static trim must be removed by the rate integrator (ArduPilot's convention I = P), so the hover phase searches the rate I too. Yaw, altitude and horizontal keep the PX4 ranges (the yaw loop needs the PX4 rate P range to meet the 0.5 Hz phase gate). Hard gates: ArduPilot's yaw loop is shaped more slowly by design (ATC_ACCEL_Y_MAX, yaw rate filters): with ArduPilot's default gains the 0.5 Hz yaw phase lag is 77 deg (EAMS, 3 ms), so the angle gate is 90 deg instead of PX4's 50. Position phase (apply after tuning/tools/add_position_phase.py): a long, fast mission like PX4's SITL check (30 m north at 5 m/s, back turning to heading 179 (180 leaves the turn direction undecided, the two may turn opposite ways), 30 m east; PID_POS_MAX_SPD 5 for that mission only, as the SITL check commands 5 m/s), scored and gated on its attitude ripple (roll/pitch wobble about their course), and the horizontal velocity P and D searched with the position gain, because a ringing velocity loop is what wobbles the attitude. The tilt saturation gate is 3 s: the 30 m legs accelerate and brake at the tilt limit for about 2.5 s. Angle phase: a 30 s level hover after the step and sine runs (suite.hold), gated on roll/pitch peak (3 deg) and on the attitude wobble not growing (last third <= 3x the first): a rate loop whose integral outweighs its P passed the 12 s runs and diverged in the altitude phase's longer hover once the vehicle flew clear of the ground (altitude from the takeoff point). The rate I range is 0..0.5, no larger than the rate P range (ArduPilot's default I = P). Altitude phase: with the altitude from the takeoff point the vehicle really climbs 0.5 m (in the world frame the EAMS sat at its 0.47 m rest height, so the phase was judged on the ground). The step is 0.5 m (a 0.1 m step's 5 mm settle band is inside the EKF's 2-3 cm baro drift), the takeoff climb may reach the configured climb speed (ArduPilot shapes it to WPNAV_SPEED_UP 2.5 m/s; 2.75 with margin), and the takeoff may cross the target up to 3 times (the crossing count has no band).
